scope: Independent content approval only: thirty named MASTER30 formative lessons with frozen teaching notes and12 newly authored MCQs each. Not a certification of original100-item banks, diagnostic bank or IELTS band. No automated grading of open-ended self-practice.

protected_independence.scope: Union of current diagnostic/confirmation/holdout status, runtime items, linked stimulus families/parallel sets, and historical protected IDs;1229 MCQs with text among1234 protected IDs.
protected_independence.method: Candidate discovery across English stimulus fragments in all authored prompts/options/notes and all protected prompts/options, plus contextual manual review of source and newly authored stories. Automated similarity is supporting evidence, not approval. Close B03/B07/B10/B16/B27 contexts rewritten; source banks retained.
protected_independence.final_B16_resolution: Number-increasing example replaced by fixed pottery catalogue47.60%-water-used task replaced by quarter of equipment relocated by warehouse staff, retaining quantity agreement and perfect passive but changing amount, referent, action and context. pedagogical_verification.B07: Six strands B01–B06 covered in notes and question map; integrated NP/case task and targeted return routes.

pedagogical_verification.B30: Task1 data accuracy plus integrated tense/agreement/passive/linking revision and learner self-diagnosis/48hour transfer plan.
pedagogical_verification.distractors: Three credible wrong options with accurate mechanisms; same N-label allowed for genuinely different actual errors. No three-distinct quota imported from original100-bank SPEC.
